title: Clinton and the ALH 84001 meteorite as slow-drip disclosure

tellings.quote: Like, there was already a meteor meteorite in the '90s that, you know, Clinton came out with ALH 84001

plain: In the 1990s President Bill Clinton publicly announced findings about ALH 84001, a meteorite from Mars that some scientists thought might hold signs of ancient life. Michels brings it up himself, without naming a source, in an episode with Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant, as an example of the government slowly releasing hints that we are not alone.
